name: Navigation
summary: Navigation for the AhaSlides marketing sites: the Site navbar, a sticky white navigation with mega-menus (the Products menu ends in a video preview of each interactive slide) collapsing to a hamburger drawer at 991px and below. The participant bar that sits directly before it is its own component, Join bar.
highlights: Place the Join bar component directly before it and the bar scrolls away while the navigation stays stuck to the top, with no positioning script
Mega-menus open on hover with a fade and slide, the chevron turns; Products has three columns and a video preview, Solutions has use cases and integration logos, Resources two columns

Products preview is a muted looping clip of the interactive slide under the pointer (the clips of the live ahaslides.com menu): it plays only while the menu is open, shows its poster under reduced motion, and is hidden at 991px and below, where its clip never loads
Hamburger drawer at 991px and below slides down; its menus are an accordion; the language menu opens on click

Brand mark is <aha-product-lockup>, icons are <aha-icon> by name, integration logos come from the Logo library; Log in and Sign up are <aha-button variant="secondary|primary" size="lg" href> and Join is <aha-button size="sm" type="submit">, with no button CSS of their own
Webflow component Header, variant name "Variant", matched to the live ahaslides.com at 1440px and 390px
layoutsIntro: One layout, the Site navbar. A page with a Join bar (Marketing > Join bar) places it directly before the Site navbar, as siblings in the same parent, so the bar scrolls away and the navbar sticks.

layouts.name: Site navbar
layouts.summary: The AhaSlides marketing site header (Webflow component Header, variant name "Variant"), matched to the live ahaslides.com: a sticky white navigation with Products, Solutions and Resources mega-menus that open on hover, Pricing, Enterprise, the language menu and Log in / Sign up, collapsing to a hamburger drawer at 991px and below. The Products menu ends in a video preview of the interactive slide under the pointer, using the same clips as the live ahaslides.com menu: it plays muted and looped only while the menu is open, pauses when it closes, shows only its poster under prefers-reduced-motion or data-aha-motion="off", and is hidden at 991px and below, where its clip never loads. Place the Join bar component (Marketing > Join bar) directly before it to get the participant bar that scrolls away. Framework-free and bound to the shared --aha-* tokens.
